labels.caption: Time per slow-loop slot of Sublet and critical-ratio renting (its inner policy) against sites $\times$ LLMs, each job alone on the host: (a) the full and (b) the reduced menu, the median over 4 alignments of a day with min--max bars; (c) the guard's time per slot on the full menu in one alignment, in total and by part: the safe expert's step, the online lower bound, the guard's test, the projection and the rest. A slow-loop slot is 300 s. The guard's overhead, Sublet's time minus critical-ratio renting's, is at most 7.95e+03 ms per slot (median over the alignments, at the full menu at $V=64$ with LLM tiers S, M, L).
